roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, policy adherence, and outbreak management to maintain a safe and healthy environment.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate. We are looking for a proactive and experienced RN ready to make a significant impact on our facility's quality of care and staff competency.
requirements: Experience in staff development or adult education
Experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 based on experience.

description:
Join a highly reputable commercial services company known for its exceptional employee retention, where professionals build long-lasting careers. We are seeking skilled HVAC Field Managers to oversee commercial and industrial projects across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area, including parts of Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana. This is an outstanding opportunity for experienced leaders to contribute to a company where dedication is valued and rewarded.

As an HVAC Field Manager, you will play a crucial role in managing field operations, ensuring the successful execution of HVAC projects, and leading a team of technicians. This position offers the chance to work with a diverse range of commercial and industrial systems, including boilers and chillers, within a dynamic and supportive environment. If you are a seasoned HVAC professional looking for a stable and rewarding career with a company that truly values its employees, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum 5-7 years of experience in HVAC.
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience, including expertise with boilers and chillers.
Experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) environment is a plus.
Ability to travel within the Chicago Metropolitan Area (IL, WI & IN).
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $50-$65 per hour, based on experience.
